turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, this is Karan from Udaan Credit Finance. This call is recorded for quality and compliance. Am I speaking with Ms. Priya Menon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. For verification, could you please tell me your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's the ninth of March, nineteen eighty nine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for confirming. I'm calling to remind you that your personal loan EMI of nine thousand two hundred rupees is due on the fifth.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Actually this month is a bit heavy for me. My daughter just got admission in an engineering college and I have to arrange her fees next month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Will the EMI be paid through auto-debit as usual?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the auto-debit is fine. Also my son wants a scooter for college, so we are thinking of buying a second two-wheeler soon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay ma'am. Please keep sufficient balance in your account one day before the due date.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time, have a nice day.
